name: unc-51 like kinase 4

function.text: ULK4 encodes inactive serine/threonine-protein kinase ULK4. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. It participates in microtubule cytoskeleton organization and protein kinase C deactivation.
